title: Paris
html_source:
Internal narrative again. Joyce echoes phrases from his poem: Giacomo Joyce which features the Italian city of Trieste. Joyce lectured (on Hamlet) there and tutored English lessons to the well todo of Trieste. Giacomo Joyce is overtly autobiographical and written as Portrait of the Artist was being finished (Ellmann, R. James Joyce: Poems and shorter writings, FF). Many, many phrases from Ulysses and Portrait are used, alluded to or morphed in Giacomo. The majority of notes (Ellmann, R. James Joyce: Poems and shorter writings, FF) refer to other works of Joyce – Exiles, Ulysses, Portrait.

It was in Trieste that Joyce changed to creating a subtle and imaginative art (Ellmann, James Joyce) :So he brought, in the person of Ulysses, the bright though unsentamentalized Mediterranean world to somber Dublin.

Joyce abandoned the poem and it only came to light through his brother Stanislaus. It is chronologically and artistically between finishing Portrait of the artist as a young man and Ulysses. (Ellmann, R & Whittier-Ferguson,J James Joyce Poems and Shorter Writings, ff).

anchor.suffix: rawly waking, crude sunlight on her lemon streets. Moist pith of farls of bread, the froggreen wormwood, her matin incense, court the air. Belluomo rises from the bed of his wife'
